purpose: Concept ideas, not implemented gameplay assets

concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium concept board for an existing Unity 2D side-scrolling vertical-climbing arena game, design exploration only.
Style: crisp richly shaded 2D game sprite illustration with dark outlines, chunky readable silhouettes, small armored chibi adventurer for scale, sophisticated pixel-art-inspired textures; NOT 3D rendering, NOT photorealism, no gore.
Composition: landscape board, about 1536x1024. Top 65 percent is a strictly SIDE-ON playable cutaway of TWO platform floors in a wider seven-floor climbing tower. Show ladders, cover and a clear cyan dashed alternative climbing route. Bottom 35 percent contains THREE spacious detail cards with enlarged prop drawings and concise English labels only. Use orange/red telegraph markings for danger, cyan for safe routes. Gameplay equipment should be visually integrated into terrain. Player and all props obey the same 2D plane. Draw stationary machine gun clearly as an occupiable emplacement on a bolted pedestal, a small armored player operating it, bounded forward firing arc, ammo crate and a small heat indicator. Opponent silhouettes are optional small game dummies, not realistic people. The rear of the emplacement is reachable by a ladder/flank route. Traps show warning-before-activation using a translucent danger zone and a small inset of inactive versus active states. Do not depict real engineering, wiring diagrams, weapon manufacture, dimensions, or mechanisms inside weapons. Focus on fictional gameplay readability. No cluttered HUD, no paragraphs, no logos/watermarks. Theme: NEON CITY, midnight blue urban rooftops, cyan/magenta signs, rising flood water far beneath the lower floor. Title exactly "NEON CITY / TACTICAL PROPS". Three cards: "01 MOUNTED MG" a cyan futuristic manned mounted machine gun protected by low cover; "02 LASER GATE" a visibly pulsing red horizontal barrier in a short corridor with a ladder bypass above; "03 SHOCK FLOOR" three glowing electrified floor tiles and a nearby visibly linked game switch. In main scene show a crouched player taking the covered lower route beneath the MG firing line and another climbing above laser. All three features appear at useful legible size in the main scene.
